title: Disk tier-down opportunities
description: Identifies managed disks provisioned at a higher tier than their actual IOPS/throughput demands.
example_prompt: "List all Premium SSD and Ultra Disk managed disks. Compare their actual P95 IOPS and throughput over the last 14 days against provisioned tier limits. Recommend tier-down to Standard SSD where actual usage is below Standard SSD limits. Show savings estimate."
